messages:
elaine_support: FYI customer ACME reported they dropped to 0 credits overnight, then saw a partial refill ~20m later and got a bunch of 429s. They’re on a paid plan.

sam_ops: opened supp ticket #S-4981 and pulled traces. attaching minimal repro notes. any quick ideas?

chris_sre: do we know the tenant timezone? midnight boundary questions often sneak in here.

elaine_support: tenant tz = America/Los_Angeles. they run a heavy nightly import that starts ~23:50 local and streams embeddings for ~30–45m.

sam_ops: logs show repeated streaming sessions and reconnect storms, token counters draining continuously. sample snippet:

```text
2026-03-16T07:49:30.123Z tenant=acme-1234 conn=0xabc tokens=119820 -> 119300
2026-03-16T07:50:02.456Z tenant=acme-1234 conn=0xabc retry=1 err=429 tokens=118900
2026-03-16T07:50:45.789Z tenant=acme-1234 conn=0xabc retry=2 err=500 tokens=118200
``` 

chris_sre: reminder: our monthly and daily refill job runs at 00:00 UTC. LA midnight is 08:00 UTC — so heavy jobs that start before local midnight can cross the UTC boundary and consume tokens before the refill.

elaine_support: customer insists they had ~120k before bed and woke up to 0. they’re confused because their billing cycle last month matched expectations.

sam_ops: two likely contributors: 1) inflight streaming reconnects double-dipping tokens (client-side retries), 2) UI/cache visibility lag after refill — API may have been refilled but UI/backend cache showed stale balance for a bit.

chris_sre: quick repro steps I used locally:
1) set tenant tz to America/Los_Angeles
2) start a long streaming session at 23:48 local, then trigger 8x reconnects across 00:02 UTC
3) watch /internal/quotas and billing/refill logs

If you want to reproduce: run this snippet against staging (one-off):

```bash
# naive load: 10 concurrent streams for 20 mins
for i in {1..10}; do ./stream-client --tenant acme-1234 &
done
sleep 1200
# trigger reconnect storm
pkill -HUP stream-client || true
``` 

elaine_support: I’ll relay that repro + explanation. also asked if they can reschedule the import to after 08:05 UTC as a workaround.

sam_ops: I queued a cache reindex for that tenant and flagged the refill job timeline — watching metrics for next 48h.

quota-bot: reindex requested for tenant acme-1234 by sam_ops — estimated propagation 120s :gear:

chris_sre: longer-term: add tenant-level inflight protection and a modest per-tenant burst buffer (soft reserve) to avoid full-zero before refill. I’ll draft a PR to default to 5% burst guard for paid plans.

elaine_support: also suggested telling customer about dedicated burst pools or Dedicated tier if they need predictable night jobs.

sam_ops: follow-ups: chris -> PR for guard, elaine -> customer note + suggested mitigation, sam -> monitor refill traces and post back.

elaine_support: thanks all :heart: will update ticket with repro steps & docs link about refill windows and streaming best practices.
__notes: thread created to triage a customer report about overnight credit depletion; internal-only conversation (no customer messages included).
